ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 3.7 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.94, 2026-06-30: 1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-29: 0.88, 2025-06-28: 0.94)
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-12-29..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: the year most of each fiscal year falls in — two fiscal years end in the same calendar year; join on period_end, not the label
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-06-30

share_issuance.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-27..2026-06-30

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

net_buyback_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

legs.share_issuance: not filed for any of the four quarters

shareholder_yield.note: an upper bound — the issuance leg is filed for only some quarters or not at all

dividend_yield.basis: FY2025 DPS 3.7 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.94, 2026-06-30: 1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-29: 0.88, 2025-06-28: 0.94)

dividend_yield.note: FY2025 DPS 3.7 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 0.94, 2026-06-30: 1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-29: 0.88, 2025-06-28: 0.94)
